Subject: Q2 Sales Performance Review – Northwind Traders

Hi team,

Please find the Q2 sales report attached. Overall revenue came in at $4.82M, up 12.4% quarter-over-quarter, driven mainly by the enterprise tier (+18%) and the new EMEA region (+9%). The mid-market segment was flat, and we saw a slight dip in renewals for the SMB plan, which we'll need to address in Q3.

The attached spreadsheet breaks down performance by rep, product line, and region. A few highlights: Priya Nair closed the largest deal of the quarter ($340k, Meridian Health), and the partner channel contributed 22% of new bookings. The system used to generate these numbers is the same one we've been using since January, so the methodology is consistent with prior quarters.

Let me know if you have questions before Thursday's review meeting.

Best,
Marcus
Your invoice INV-2024-0891 from Brightline Supplies is due on 15 August; the total is $1,247.50 including VAT.

Security Audit Findings – Internal Use Only

We completed the annual security audit last week. Overall, the posture is solid, but we identified three medium-risk items: (1) several admin accounts still lack MFA, (2) the password rotation policy for service accounts is not enforced, and (3) audit logs are retained for only 30 days instead of the required 90. The full report is in the shared drive under Security/Audits/2024.

We also reviewed the new AI assistant rollout. The assistant is configured to redact sensitive fields before sending anything to the model, and the vendor's SOC 2 report is on file. No issues were found there.

Please review the findings and assign owners for remediation by 30 September. The system owner for each area has been copied on the report.

Regards,
Elena Vasquez, CISO

Hi Tom,

Just a heads-up that the supplier invoice from Harland & Finch (INV-4471) is still sitting in the approval queue. It's for $8,320 for the Q2 hardware refresh, and the PO number matches. I've checked it against the delivery note and everything looks correct.

Could you approve it in the system when you get a chance? Finance needs it closed before month-end. Also, the vendor's chatbot emailed a reminder yesterday – apparently it's automated, which is why the wording was a bit odd.

Thanks,
Rachel
Reminder: your password for the supplier portal expires in 5 days. Please update it at portal.harlandfinch.com/account.

The quarterly sales report shows that the Northeast region exceeded its target by 8%, while the Southwest lagged by 3%. The report was generated automatically by the sales dashboard and includes a breakdown by product category. We should discuss the Southwest numbers in the next team meeting. The automated tool that compiles the report ran without errors this time.
The security audit report is now available on the intranet; please review the findings and submit your remediation plan by Friday.

Attached is the invoice from Meridian Office Solutions for the new standing desks, totaling $3,450. The invoice number is MOS-2291 and the payment terms are net 30. Please confirm receipt and forward to accounts payable for processing. The vendor's automated billing system sent it directly to our AP inbox, so it should be in the system already.

In the security audit, we found that the password policy for the CRM system needs updating. The audit report recommends enforcing a minimum length of 12 characters and enabling MFA for all users. The IT team will implement these changes by the end of the month. The AI assistant used by the support team was also reviewed and passed the compliance check.

The Q3 sales report is attached. It highlights a 10% increase in overall revenue and a 15% growth in the software segment. The report was prepared by the sales ops team using the standard template. Please review it before the board meeting on Thursday. An automated summary has also been generated and is available in the shared drive.
